title: Rafael and the Contact
author: Felix Crane
blurb: Oscar Vasquez, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
